target.title: feat(qwen): add Token Plan (Team Edition) provider
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

OpenClaw supports Qwen Standard, Coding Plan, and OAuth, but not Alibaba Cloud Token Plan (Team Edition) as a first-class provider. Token Plan users currently need a large manual provider definition, and Alibaba's documented `bailian-token-plan` example must remain an exact custom-provider contract rather than becoming a canonical catalog alias.

Closes #94418.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds canonical `qwen-token-plan` support with:

- Global/Singapore and China/Beijing onboarding choices and dedicated endpoints.
- The current exact 14-model Token Plan chat catalog.
- Model-specific thinking behavior for Qwen, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, and MiniMax, including replay and tool-call wire constraints.
- Native streaming-usage compatibility and isolated `QWEN_TOKEN_PLAN_API_KEY` handling.
- Independent runtime compatibility for Alibaba's documented `bailian-token-plan` custom-provider ID.

`bailian-token-plan` intentionally has runtime hooks only—no built-in auth, discovery catalog, static catalog, or environment variables—so existing custom transport, credentials, model rows, and explicit thinking formats remain authoritative.

Config-risk metric: +2 provider IDs, +2 auth choices, +1 environment variable, +2 native endpoints, and +14 catalog rows. All additions are additive; no existing provider ID or config shape changes.

## User Impact

Users can onboard with `qwen-token-plan` or `qwen-token-plan-cn`, authenticate with a region-matched Token Plan key, and select models such as `qwen-token-plan/qwen3.7-plus`. Existing `bailian-token-plan/*` configurations continue using their explicitly configured transport and catalog.

Token Plan is documented for interactive coding and agent use. The provider docs warn against cron, unattended batch, and application-backend use that can violate the subscription terms.

## Evidence

- Testbox `tbx_01kx3r67gg3788ydbktswk1x2d` — [Actions run 29029979874](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29029979874): extension production/test types passed; 62 stream behavior tests passed.
- Testbox `tbx_01kx3rrnapm9etmm41yw1sq5ds` — [Actions run 29030650617](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29030650617): 93 Qwen plugin tests passed after rebasing onto current `main`.
- Testbox `tbx_01kx3s68spj9h41yfeqwxpxnw2d` — [Actions run 29031140942](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29031140942): the complete docs gate passed after regenerating `docs/docs_map.md`, including markdown lint, MDX validation, 0 broken links, and the generated-map check.
- Plugin inventory generation check, targeted extension lint/format, JSON parsing, and `git diff --check` passed.
- Fresh whole-diff Codex autoreview: no accepted or actionable findings.
- Exact-head live Global Token Plan proof is pending completion of the subscription/API-key setup. The PR will not be landed until onboarding, catalog, text, tool, vision, thinking-only, DeepSeek replay, GLM effort, and `deepseek-v3.2` availability are exercised through OpenClaw.

The implementation preserves contributor credit with `Co-authored-by: Oliver Mee <102673257+Omee11@users.noreply.github.com>`.
